name: ASCII Candle Grid

name: Block Sparkline Watchlist
note: One eighth-block sparkline per instrument rescaled to its own 18-tick window, with every tick snapped to that instrument's tick size and the rate row quoted in basis points.

name: Diverging Exposure Bars
note: A text bar chart diverging from a centre rule, using full blocks plus half-block remainders so each bar resolves to half a cell, with long/short/gross/net totals summed from the rows.
html: NET EXPOSURE · % NAVBOOK EQ-LS-01

name: Session Returns Heatmap
note: A heatmap whose cells encode magnitude twice — shade character and hue — so the grid still reads without colour, with period returns compounded from the same cells.
html: DAILY RETURN GRID 12 SESSCLOSE/CLOSE

name: Depth Ladder Bars
note: A price ladder where each level's size is a block-glyph bar growing away from the centre price column; totals, imbalance and the tick spread are recomputed from the live book each refresh.
html:

name: Time & Sales Tape
note: A scrolling print tape with a log-scaled block bar per size; VWAP is accumulated from every print shown and the last price is quoted against it in basis points.
html:

name: Return Distribution Histogram
note: A column histogram built from eighth-block partial tops with a normal fit plotted as dots above the bars; every statistic in the panel is computed from the same 250-observation sample.
html: DAILY LOG RET SPX INDEX250 SESS

name: Beta / Return Scatter
note: A monospace scatter plot that stacks collisions as a digit count and draws its own least-squares fit as dotted cells; portfolio beta, weighted return and R-squared come from the plotted names.
